D/ [---]PF AVG ; R/ FEL TEMP REPARATIO

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Soldier and hut issue of 348-350, possibly mint of Rome, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust draped and diademed left holding globe; pierced through globe by a drilled hole. Obverse inscription: [---]PF AVG.
